text:
becky.marketing: Quick preflight for Wed webinar + benchmark post. Need a tight runbook: final keyword set, JSON-LD (Event, VideoObject, HowTo/FAQ), internal link map, and redirect sweep. Can @sam.seo and @marta_ops eyeball? Draft doc: https://tiny.redwood/bench-runbook

sam.seo: Yep. I'll run a SERP intent + longtail pull now. Which URL are we declaring canonical for the narrative post?

becky.marketing: Canonical = /learn/benchmarks-2025. Product page /product/benchmarks will be secondary and should link to the learn page with descriptive anchor text. Seed keywords to include on the hero and H1: "inference throughput benchmarks", "latency vs batching benchmark", "inference cost benchmark". Sam, expand with 6 long-tail phrases and prioritize by intent.

sam.seo: Longtails (prelim): "throughput performance by GPU model", "batch-size latency tradeoffs in inference", "quantized model latency comparisons", "reduce inference cost per request", "benchmarking LLM serving for startups", "benchmarking dedicated inference clusters". Anchor plan: link to /docs/batching (anchor: "batching and latency tradeoffs"), /pricing/discounts (anchor: "inference pricing examples"), /case-studies/ai-startups (anchor: "startup benchmark case studies"). Avoid vague CTAs like "learn more" — use descriptive anchors.

marta_ops: Canonical confirmed: https://redwood.com/learn/benchmarks-2025. UTM params for emails/ads: ?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bench_launch_may. I'll coordinate deploy window.

leo_sre: FYI redirect-scan flagged an orphan: /benchmarks-old currently 302 -> /blog/legacy-benchmarks. That collides with our promo path. Recommend consolidation before blasts.

ops-bot: redirect-check: /benchmarks-old -> 302 -> /blog/legacy-benchmarks. Recommendation: create 301 from /benchmarks-old -> /learn/benchmarks-2025. Commands: `redirect-scan --path /benchmarks*` then `redirect-plan --create 301 /benchmarks-old /learn/benchmarks-2025 --note \"consolidate launch\"`

becky.marketing: OK — sam + marta freeze KW & schema by EOD. leo, can you open a release ticket for the redirect change? Include rollback plan.

leo_sre: Created ticket RED-3579 for redirect consolidation + canonical swap, assigned to eng-release. Cutover ETA Tue 10am PT, rollback plan included.

marta_ops: Scheduling redirect change Tue 10am PT and will post to #release-war-room. QA checklist for post-cutover: 1) Screaming Frog crawl for redirect chain; 2) JSON-LD validation via https://validator.schema.org; 3) Confirm rel=canonical points to /learn/benchmarks-2025; 4) smoke test page load + canonical in mobile UA.

sam.seo: Also adding HowTo structured data for a short "how to run a quick LLM inference benchmark" snippet to increase chances of rich result. Set `mainEntityOfPage` to canonical, and include event/video markup for the webinar recording. Will paste JSON-LD into the doc for review.

ops-bot: schema-validate: sample JSON-LD check OK (prelim). Reminder: include `\"@context\": \"https://schema.org\"` and avoid embedding site-specific query strings in `mainEntityOfPage`.

becky.marketing: Lovely. Action list: sam finalize KW list + anchor suggestions, sam paste JSON-LD snippets, marta schedule redirect and run QA, leo own release ticket. Ping this thread when done. Promo copy locked once redirect is confirmed :rocket:
